from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Metric data extracted from one university's Common Data Set document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    total_undergraduate_population: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment count")
    freshman_housing_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of freshmen living in college housing (e.g., 98.0 for 98%)")
    classes_below_100_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of class sections with fewer than 100 students")
    total_class_sections: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate class sections")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic period or reporting date for the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
